title: yian.cli.v1
description: The documents yian's --json commands write. A command writes exactly one JSON object and a newline on stdout, and nothing else there. Every document has "format": "yian.cli.v1". Keys are snake_case. Every key a document lists is always present (null where it allows null). Consumers ignore unknown keys; keys are only added within v1. Codes and enum values are only added within v1; a consumer treats an unknown error code as a generic error and ignores an unknown login method. Message and note text is not part of the contract, nor are the number and order of `config check` errors; codes and fields are. Conformance cases still pin the number and order, so the implementations agree. Numbers use yian's lossless JSON form: a float always has a fraction or an exponent (2.0), an int never does. Exit codes: 0 success; 1 a reported problem, with its document on stdout; 2 a usage error (text on stderr, no document); 130 stopped by SIGINT (no document). Any other exit, a crash included (exit 1 with a traceback), has no document; a consumer treats stdout that doesn't parse as an internal error. stderr is free-form.

frame.description: A source location: range is [start_line, start_col, end_line, end_col], 1-based with an exclusive end column. note is left out when empty.

diagnostic.description: A problem with a code, a message and its source frames, outermost first. frames and notes are left out when empty.

failure.description: A diagnostic plus `node`: the id of the node that failed, or null when no single node did.

run_document.description: `yian run --json` (fresh or --resume): the run's terminal result. A run that fails exits 1 with status failed.

output.description: The flow's output in yian's JSON codec form (conformance/README.md): plain JSON, a file as {uri, mime, name}, a float infinity as {"$float": "inf"} or {"$float": "-inf"}, and a mapping that would read as one of those or whose only key is $record wrapped in {"$record": ...}.

error_document.description: Written by a --json command that exits 1 without its own result document.

input.description: One declared flow input. type is the canonical type label (int, Optional(str), a typedef expanded as {"age":int,"name":str}).

flow_result.description: One flow `yian check` loaded; path is the argument exactly as given.

check_document.description: `yian check --json`: one result per flow argument, in argument order.

config_error.description: One problem with an llm_config layer. field is the location joined with `.` (base_url, openai.temperature), or null for an unknown top-level key, which is never named, or a problem with no single field. A provider block reports its own field problems, an unknown key in it included, at field: <block> (openai).

config_document.description: `yian config check --json`: the llm_config layer on stdin, checked as a run checks it. ok is true exactly when errors is empty. Values never appear in messages; an unknown top-level key is never named, but a provider block's messages name its own keys.

provider.description: One supported provider: the login kinds `yian auth` can save for it, and the environment variable its API key is read from (null when it takes no key).

providers_document.description: `yian providers --json`: every supported provider, in yian's order.

skill_result.description: One skill directory `yian skills check` loaded; path is the argument exactly as given.

skills_document.description: `yian skills check --json`: one result per skill directory argument, in argument order. Two directories with one skill name are not reported.
